sources.title: The Illustrated GPT-2 (Visualizing Transformer Language Models)
sources.snippet: The GPT2 was, however, a very large, transformer-based language model trained on a massive dataset. In this post, we'll look at the architecture that enabled the model to produce its results. We will go into the depths of its self-attention layer. And then we'll look at applications for the decoder-only transformer beyond language modeling.

sources.title: OpenAI GPT2 — transformers 4.2.0 documentation - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview ¶ OpenAI GPT-2 model was proposed in Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners by Alec Radford, Jeffrey Wu, Rewon Child, David Luan, Dario Amodei and Ilya Sutskever. It's a causal (unidirectional) transformer pretrained using language modeling on a very large corpus of ~40 GB of text data.
